text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm, another perfect day for a nap~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, there's a nice spot open.
I think I'll go ahead and take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Brrr, so cold. To think a pro napper like myself
would misjudge when to wake up... Achoo!
